Pocket Arcade

Pocket Arcade

Arrow keys and Enter, or a game controller’s D-pad and A button, pick a game. Esc (or B) comes back here. Progress saves in this browser.

How to play

  • Place one piece in every row, every column, and every color.
  • Pieces can't touch, not even diagonally.

Tap to mark ✕, tap again to clear. Double-tap to place a piece. Drag to mark ✕ on several squares, or start a drag on an ✕ to erase a line of them. Correct pieces lock in place (rounded tile). Finish with no mistakes and no hints for 3 stars. The timer starts on your first move.
